_comment: Config for scripts/sync-events.mjs. Every active group in src/data/groups.json with a meetupUrl is checked automatically; list Meetup groups that are not in groups.json under extraMeetupGroups. Meetup feeds don't include a location, so locations sets the city used for a group's new events (default: Kansas City, MO, which the calendar hides). Add a group name to skipGroups to stop syncing it (Hammerspace KC is skipped because its feed is mostly makerspace classes such as blacksmithing). Events whose title contains any skipTitlesMatching text (case-insensitive) are ignored. When you delete a synced event from events.json, add its link to ignoreEventUrls or the next run will add it back.
